failure_policy: write trigger, sweep-1, and offending phase-T/common-T arrays to rank-local binary snapshots; abort before held-field integrity check and before pressure sweep continuation
pass_policy: log phase-T hashes and numeric deltas, then continue all eight declared mechanical sweeps; do not require phase-T hashes to remain byte-identical

diagnostic_metrics: internal global max absolute delta K
rule.if_out_of_bound: write trigger, sweep-1, and offending phase-T/common-T arrays to rank-local binary snapshots; abort before held-field integrity check and before pressure sweep continuation
rule.if_within_bound: log phase-T hashes and numeric deltas, then continue all eight declared mechanical sweeps; do not require phase-T hashes to remain byte-identical
rule.per_element_rule: abs(Tphase_current - Tphase_trigger) <= 128 * numeric_limits<scalar>::epsilon() * max(1, abs(Tphase_trigger)) for every internal cell and boundary value
rule.reference: each phase temperature at physical map trigger, after the original physical outer-8/corrector-2/EOS/U/K completion and before any mechanical-map operation
